summary: Reserves an Enterprise Number, in the SMI Network Management Private Enterprise Code space, for use in documentation. Writers can then use this number in examples without borrowing a real company's number. It is informational.

plainLanguage.summary: RFC 5612 reserves Enterprise Number 32473 for examples in documents. It says implementations should not send this number or treat it specially when received.

subtitle: Enterprise Number 32473 is reserved for examples in documentation.

tldr.problem: Examples in technical documents need an Enterprise Number that is not taken from another organization's assignment.
tldr.mechanism: The RFC allocates Enterprise Number 32473 for examples in RFCs, books, documentation and similar material.
tldr.outcome: The number is not intended for implementation or special treatment by software. RFC 5612 is Informational.

today: RFC 5612 is an Informational RFC published in August 2009. The unit metadata lists no RFC that obsoletes or updates it.

sections.title: What Enterprise Numbers Identify
sections.content:
An object identifier subtree can identify management objects defined by one party, such as an enterprise. The subtree begins with 1.3.6.1.4.1. followed by the Enterprise Number assigned to that enterprise. IANA allocates Enterprise Numbers.

The RFC lists uses in other protocols, including Syslog, RADIUS, Mobile IPv4, RSVP, DHCPv4 and IPFIX. Documents about these protocols may include Enterprise Numbers in examples.
sections.plainLanguage: Enterprise Numbers identify parts of an object identifier space assigned to organizations. Documents may include these numbers when they show protocol examples.

sections.title: The Number for Documentation
sections.content:
To reduce the chance of conflict or confusion, IANA allocated Enterprise Number 32473 for use in RFCs, books, documentation and similar examples.

The number is not intended to be implemented. The RFC does not expect implementations to send it or to treat it specially when receiving it.
sections.plainLanguage: Use 32473 when an example needs an Enterprise Number. The RFC says it is for documentation, not for software to use as an assigned organization's number.

sections.title: IANA Registration and Security
sections.content: IANA updated the registration for Enterprise Number 32473 to point to RFC 5612. The RFC says allocating this number for documentation use has no direct impact on security.
sections.plainLanguage: IANA's registration points readers to this RFC. The memo says the documentation allocation has no direct security impact.
